/* =========================================================
   Rilakkuma / Angel Heart — uwu适配版
   原美化作者：en3 / 天使   适配：小君
     ========================================================= */

/* 1. 主题变量（仅限聊天室） */
#chat-room-screen {
    --angel-bottom-icon-size: 22px;
    --angel-control-icon: url("https://i.postimg.cc/zBbnh7xV/IMG-0714.png");
    --angel-bubble-decoration: url("https://i.postimg.cc/SKjZZWgP/IMG-0719.png");
    --angel-header-image: url("https://i.postimg.cc/mrnqYdNv/73A4F2FC-3BF6-4A7D-AB39-6BF3294847A2.jpg");
    --angel-header-text: #7e7e7e;
    --angel-bottom-bg: #fcfafb;
}
body.night-mode-active #chat-room-screen {
    --angel-header-image: url("https://i.postimg.cc/5y2BS89G/IMG-3008.jpg");
    --angel-header-text: #333333;
    --angel-bottom-bg: #f3f3f3;
}

/* 2. 顶栏：保留 uwu 的正常文档流，避免覆盖聊天记录。
   不强制 display，普通顶栏/多选顶栏继续由原 JS 切换。 */
#chat-room-screen #chat-room-header-default {
    position: relative !important;
    flex-shrink: 0 !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    height: calc(58px + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px)) !important;
    min-height: calc(58px + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px)) !important;
    padding: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) 18px 0 !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    justify-content: space-between !important;
    background: transparent var(--angel-header-image) center / 100% 100% no-repeat !important;
    border: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    backdrop-filter: none !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
    overflow: visible !important;
}
#chat-room-screen #chat-room-header-default .title-container {
    position: absolute !important;
    left: 50% !important;
    top: calc(env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) + 29px) !important;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) !important;
    display: flex !important;
    flex-direction: column !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    justify-content: center !important;
    width: max-content !important;
    max-width: calc(100% - 184px) !important;
    min-width: 0 !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    gap: 0 !important;
    text-align: center !important;
    pointer-events: none !important;
}
#chat-room-screen #chat-room-header-default .title-container > div {
    max-width: 100% !important;
    min-width: 0 !important;
}
#chat-room-screen #chat-room-header-default #chat-room-title {
    position: static !important;
    transform: none !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
    min-width: 0 !important;
    overflow: hidden !important;
    white-space: nowrap !important;
    text-overflow: ellipsis !important;
    font-size: 15px !important;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
    line-height: 1.2 !important;
    letter-spacing: 0 !important;
    color: var(--angel-header-text) !important;
    text-align: center !important;
    text-shadow: none !important;
    -webkit-text-stroke: 0 !important;
    font-synthesis: none !important;
}
#chat-room-screen #chat-room-title * {
    font-family: inherit !important;
    font-size: inherit !important;
    font-weight: inherit !important;
    line-height: inherit !important;
    color: inherit !important;
    text-shadow: none !important;
}
#chat-room-screen #chat-room-subtitle {
    display: none !important;
}
/* 将 uwu原状态按钮的透明点击区域覆盖到备注名上。
   不强制 display：仅私聊且开启「启用角色状态栏」时生效。
   复用原按钮绑定的打开逻辑，群聊及多选模式保持原行为。 */
#chat-room-screen #char-status-btn {
    position: absolute !important;
    left: 50% !important;
    top: 50% !important;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    min-width: 44px !important;
    height: 44px !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    border: none !important;
    background: transparent !important;
    opacity: 0 !important;
    z-index: 3 !important;
    cursor: pointer !important;
    pointer-events: auto !important;
}
/* 键盘导航时给备注名显示可见焦点。 */
#chat-room-screen .title-container:has(#char-status-btn:focus-visible) #chat-room-title {
    outline: 1px solid #b4a6ad !important;
    outline-offset: 4px !important;
    border-radius: 3px !important;
}
#chat-room-screen #chat-room-header-default .action-btn-group {
    position: relative !important;
    z-index: 2 !important;
    display: flex !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    justify-content: flex-end !important;
    gap: 12px !important;
    flex-shrink: 0 !important;
}
#chat-room-screen #chat-room-header-default :is(.back-btn, .action-btn) {
    position: relative !important;
    width: 30px !important;
    min-width: 30px !important;
    height: 30px !important;
    min-height: 30px !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    background: transparent !important;
    border: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    font-size: 0 !important;
    color: transparent !important;
    cursor: pointer !important;
}
#chat-room-screen #chat-room-header-default :is(.back-btn, .action-btn) > :is(svg, img) {
    opacity: 0 !important;
    visibility: hidden !important;
}
#chat-room-screen #chat-room-header-default :is(.back-btn, .action-btn)::before {
    content: "" !important;
    position: absolute !important;
    width: 22px !important;
    height: 22px !important;
    left: 50% !important;
    top: 50% !important;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) !important;
    background: var(--angel-control-icon) center / contain no-repeat !important;
    pointer-events: none !important;
}
#chat-room-screen #chat-room-header-default .back-btn::before {
    width: 21px !important;
    height: 21px !important;
}

/* 3. 普通文字气泡。
   Uwu：sent = 用户，received = 对方，正文直接在 .message-bubble。
   图片、表情、转账等使用独立类，不套文字壳。
   语音条沿用原码通用气泡外观，原播放/暂停逻辑不变。
   HTML 卡片和调试消息明确排除；保留上下文禁用标识。 */
#chat-room-screen .message-time {
    display: none !important;
}
#chat-room-screen .message-bubble:is(.sent, .received):not(.html-bubble):not(.debug-visible),
#chat-room-screen .voice-bubble {
    position: relative !important;
    padding: 4px 8px !important;
    font-size: calc(15px * var(--app-font-scale, 1)) !important;
    line-height: 1.34 !important;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
    color: #858585 !important;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82) !important;
    border: none !important;
    border-radius: 5px !important;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #f8f6f7, 0 1px 2px rgba(120, 130, 140, 0.08) !important;
    backdrop-filter: none !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
    overflow: visible !important;
    word-break: break-word !important;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere !important;
}
/* 使用 ::before，避免覆盖 Uwu 在 ::after 上显示的上下文禁用提示。 */
#chat-room-screen .message-bubble:is(.sent, .received):not(.html-bubble):not(.debug-visible)::before,
#chat-room-screen .voice-bubble::before {
    content: "" !important;
    display: block !important;
    position: absolute !important;
    top: -7px !important;
    width: 15px !important;
    height: 15px !important;
    background: var(--angel-bubble-decoration) center / contain no-repeat !important;
    transform: none !important;
    pointer-events: none !important;
    z-index: 2 !important;
}
#chat-room-screen .message-bubble.received:not(.html-bubble):not(.debug-visible)::before,
#chat-room-screen .message-wrapper.received .voice-bubble::before {
    right: -1px !important;
    left: auto !important;
}
#chat-room-screen .message-bubble.sent:not(.html-bubble):not(.debug-visible)::before,
#chat-room-screen .message-wrapper.sent .voice-bubble::before {
    left: -1px !important;
    right: auto !important;
}

/* 语音适配说明：原码没有单独的语音条或语音转文字美化段。
   原通用气泡规则未排除语音类型；此处将同款外观用于 Uwu 的
   .voice-bubble（Uwu 的语音条与 .message-bubble 是不同结构）。
   保留语音条的 flex、宽度、方向、时长、播放/暂停及转文字显隐；
   .voice-transcript 继续使用 Uwu 默认样式，不虚构原作的文字面板样式。 */

/* 4. 输入栏：保留 Uwu 的布局与键盘处理，不改成 absolute/fixed。 */
#chat-room-screen .chat-input-wrapper {
    flex-shrink: 0 !important;
    background: var(--angel-bottom-bg) !important;
}
#chat-room-screen #message-input-default {
    position: relative !important;
    padding: 7px 10px !important;
    padding-bottom: calc(7px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)) !important;
    gap: 8px !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    background: var(--angel-bottom-bg) !important;
    border: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    backdrop-filter: none !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
}
#chat-room-screen #message-input-default .input-wrapper {
    position: relative !important;
    flex: 1 1 auto !important;
    min-width: 0 !important;
}
#chat-room-screen #message-input {
    width: 100% !important;
    min-width: 0 !important;
    height: 30px !important;
    padding: 5px 34px 5px 13px !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
    border: none !important;
    outline: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    border-radius: 999px !important;
    background: #ffffff !important;
    color: #3d3d3d !important;
    caret-color: #6f8eaa !important;
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", "PingFang SC", sans-serif !important;
    font-size: max(16px, calc(16px * var(--app-font-scale, 1))) !important;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
    line-height: 20px !important;
}
#chat-room-screen #message-input:focus {
    background: #ffffff !important;
    outline: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
}
#chat-room-screen #message-input::placeholder {
    color: transparent !important;
    opacity: 0 !important;
}
/* Uwu 自带 placeholder=""；仅输入为空时显示，不依赖 value 属性。 */
#chat-room-screen #message-input-default .input-wrapper:has(#message-input:placeholder-shown)::after {
    content: "Angel Heart" !important;
    position: absolute !important;
    left: 13px !important;
    right: 36px !important;
    top: 50% !important;
    transform: translateY(-50%) !important;
    height: 20px !important;
    line-height: 20px !important;
    overflow: hidden !important;
    white-space: nowrap !important;
    text-overflow: ellipsis !important;
    color: #c2c2c2 !important;
    opacity: 0.92 !important;
    font-family: "Hiragino Maru Gothic ProN", "Arial Rounded MT Bold", sans-serif !important;
    font-size: 11px !important;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
    letter-spacing: 0.2px !important;
    pointer-events: none !important;
}
/* 不强制 display/opacity/pointer-events：保留发送/等待切换及禁用状态。 */
#chat-room-screen #message-input-default :is(#toggle-expansion-btn, #get-reply-btn, #send-message-btn) {
    position: relative !important;
    width: 30px !important;
    min-width: 30px !important;
    height: 30px !important;
    min-height: 30px !important;
    flex-shrink: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    background: transparent !important;
    border: none !important;
    border-radius: 0 !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    font-size: 0 !important;
    color: transparent !important;
}
#chat-room-screen #message-input-default :is(#toggle-expansion-btn, #get-reply-btn, #send-message-btn) > :is(img, svg, span) {
    opacity: 0 !important;
    visibility: hidden !important;
}
#chat-room-screen #message-input-default :is(#toggle-expansion-btn, #get-reply-btn, #send-message-btn)::before {
    content: "" !important;
    position: absolute !important;
    left: 50% !important;
    top: 50% !important;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) !important;
    width: var(--angel-bottom-icon-size) !important;
    height: var(--angel-bottom-icon-size) !important;
    background: var(--angel-control-icon) center / contain no-repeat !important;
    pointer-events: none !important;
}
#chat-room-screen #toggle-expansion-btn::before {
    opacity: 0.7 !important;
}
/* 表情键换为与左右按钮同款的纽扣；保留原按钮事件和点击区域。 */
#chat-room-screen #sticker-toggle-btn {
    background: transparent !important;
    width: 28px !important;
    height: 28px !important;
    right: 4px !important;
    border: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    font-size: 0 !important;
    color: transparent !important;
}
#chat-room-screen #sticker-toggle-btn :is(img, svg) {
    opacity: 0 !important;
    visibility: hidden !important;
}
#chat-room-screen #sticker-toggle-btn::before {
    content: "" !important;
    position: absolute !important;
    left: 50% !important;
    top: 50% !important;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) !important;
    width: var(--angel-bottom-icon-size) !important;
    height: var(--angel-bottom-icon-size) !important;
    background: var(--angel-control-icon) center / contain no-repeat !important;
    pointer-events: none !important;
}

/* 5. 功能菜单恢复 Uwu 默认。
   不覆盖 #chat-expansion-panel / #panel-function-area 下的任何菜单规则。
   原版图标、标签、尺寸、分页由 Uwu 自身 CSS 与 JS 管理。
   请用本文件完整替换上一版，勿追加，否则旧菜单覆盖规则仍会生效。 */

/* 6. 转账卡片：Uwu 的 .transfer-content 是卡片内层，不是弹窗。 */
#chat-room-screen .transfer-card {
    position: relative !important;
    width: 164px !important;
    min-width: 164px !important;
    max-width: 164px !important;
    height: auto !important;
    min-height: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
    border: none !important;
    border-radius: 14px !important;
    color: #999999 !important;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.96), rgba(248,250,252,0.94)) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #f8f3f5, 0 2px 6px rgba(80,95,110,0.10) !important;
    overflow: hidden !important;
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, "PingFang SC", sans-serif !important;
}
#chat-room-screen .transfer-card::before {
    content: "" !important;
    position: absolute !important;
    right: 9px !important;
    top: 8px !important;
    width: 9px !important;
    height: 9px !important;
    border-radius: 50% !important;
    background: #ddd1d5 !important;
    opacity: 0.75 !important;
    pointer-events: none !important;
}
#chat-room-screen .transfer-card::after {
    content: none !important;
}
#chat-room-screen .transfer-card .transfer-content {
    padding: 9px 10px 8px !important;
    gap: 0 !important;
    background: transparent !important;
    border: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
}
#chat-room-screen .transfer-card .transfer-title {
    margin: 0 12px 4px 0 !important;
    font-size: 10px !important;
    line-height: 1.2 !important;
    font-weight: 500 !important;
    color: #999999 !important;
    text-shadow: none !important;
}
#chat-room-screen .transfer-card .transfer-title::before {
    content: none !important;
    display: none !important;
}
#chat-room-screen .transfer-card .transfer-amount {
    margin: 0 0 6px !important;
    font-size: 21px !important;
    line-height: 1.08 !important;
    font-weight: 650 !important;
    letter-spacing: -0.4px !important;
    color: #999999 !important;
    text-shadow: none !important;
}
#chat-room-screen .transfer-card .transfer-remark {
    margin: 0 !important;
    font-size: 10px !important;
    line-height: 1.28 !important;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
    color: #b3afb1 !important;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere !important;
}
/* 分隔线放在真实状态栏上，备注换行时也不会压到文字。 */
#chat-room-screen .transfer-card .transfer-status {
    margin: 7px 0 0 !important;
    padding: 6px 0 0 !important;
    border-top: 1px solid #f0e9ed !important;
    border-radius: 0 !important;
    background: transparent !important;
    color: #999999 !important;
    font-size: 10px !important;
    line-height: 1.28 !important;
    text-align: left !important;
}
#chat-room-screen .transfer-card:active {
    transform: scale(0.985);
}

/* 7. 发起转账弹窗及收款操作面板：只改视觉，不改变显示开关。 */
#send-transfer-modal,
#receive-transfer-actionsheet {
    background-color: rgba(245,246,248,0.48) !important;
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px) !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px) !important;
}
#send-transfer-modal .modal-window {
    width: 260px !important;
    max-width: calc(100vw - 32px) !important;
    padding: 16px !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
    border: 1px solid #ddd1d5 !important;
    border-radius: 18px !important;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.98), rgba(247,249,251,0.96)) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #f8f3f5, 0 10px 28px rgba(70,82,95,0.16) !important;
    color: #999999 !important;
}
#send-transfer-modal h3 {
    margin: 0 0 14px !important;
    font-size: 16px !important;
    line-height: 1.2 !important;
    font-weight: 650 !important;
    color: #999999 !important;
    text-align: center !important;
}
#send-transfer-modal .form-group {
    margin-bottom: 11px !important;
}
#send-transfer-modal .form-group label {
    margin-bottom: 5px !important;
    font-size: 11px !important;
    line-height: 1.2 !important;
    font-weight: 500 !important;
    color: #999999 !important;
}
#send-transfer-modal :is(#transfer-amount-input, #transfer-remark-input) {
    width: 100% !important;
    height: 34px !important;
    padding: 6px 10px !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
    border: 1px solid #ddd1d5 !important;
    border-radius: 999px !important;
    background: #ffffff !important;
    color: #858585 !important;
    font-size: 16px !important;
    line-height: 20px !important;
    outline: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
}
#send-transfer-modal :is(#transfer-amount-input, #transfer-remark-input):focus {
    border-color: #b8c9d9 !important;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #e8eef3 !important;
}
#send-transfer-modal button[type="submit"],
#receive-transfer-actionsheet .action-sheet-button {
    min-height: 32px !important;
    padding: 7px 10px !important;
    border: none !important;
    border-radius: 999px !important;
    background: #f8f3f5 !important;
    color: #999999 !important;
    font-size: 13px !important;
    line-height: 1.4 !important;
    font-weight: 550 !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
}
#receive-transfer-actionsheet .action-sheet {
    width: 260px !important;
    max-width: calc(100% - 32px) !important;
    margin-inline: auto !important;
    padding: 16px !important;
    padding-bottom: calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)) !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
    border: 1px solid #ddd1d5 !important;
    border-radius: 18px 18px 0 0 !important;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff, #f7f9fb) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #f8f3f5, 0 -5px 28px rgba(70,82,95,0.10) !important;
}
#receive-transfer-actionsheet #accept-transfer-btn {
    background: #ffffff !important;
    margin-bottom: 8px !important;
}
#send-transfer-modal button[type="submit"]:active,
#receive-transfer-actionsheet .action-sheet-button:active {
    transform: scale(0.97);
}

/* 8. 系统时间/通知：保留中间时间条，只隐藏每条消息的时间戳。 */
#chat-room-screen .message-wrapper.system-notification:not(.independent-summary-wrapper) {
    align-items: center !important;
    margin: 6px auto !important;
    max-width: 80% !important;
}
#chat-room-screen .system-notification-bubble {
    width: fit-content !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
    padding: 2px 9px !important;
    margin: 0 auto !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
    border: none !important;
    border-radius: 999px !important;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.72) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #f8f3f5, 0 1px 2px rgba(120,130,140,0.08) !important;
    color: #999999 !important;
    font-size: 10px !important;
    line-height: 1.25 !important;
    font-weight: 500 !important;
    text-align: center !important;
    text-shadow: none !important;
    backdrop-filter: none !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
}

/* 9. 引用回复：Uwu 默认浮在气泡外，改成气泡内轻薄标签。 */
#chat-room-screen .message-wrapper:has(.message-bubble > .quoted-message) {
    margin-bottom: 12px !important;
}
#chat-room-screen .message-wrapper.group-message:has(.message-bubble > .quoted-message) {
    margin-bottom: 18px !important;
}
#chat-room-screen .quoted-message {
    position: relative !important;
    inset: auto !important;
    display: block !important;
    width: auto !important;
    height: auto !important;
    min-width: 0 !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
    margin: 0 0 5px !important;
    padding: 5px 8px 5px 10px !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
    border: none !important;
    border-radius: 9px !important;
    background: #f8f3f5 !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    text-align: left !important;
    white-space: normal !important;
    overflow: hidden !important;
    line-height: 1.32 !important;
    backdrop-filter: none !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
}
#chat-room-screen .quoted-message::before {
    content: "" !important;
    position: absolute !important;
    left: 5px !important;
    top: 7px !important;
    bottom: 7px !important;
    width: 2px !important;
    border-radius: 999px !important;
    background: #d6d6d6 !important;
    opacity: 0.86 !important;
    pointer-events: none !important;
}
#chat-room-screen .quoted-message::after,
#chat-room-screen .quoted-sender::after {
    content: none !important;
}
#chat-room-screen .quoted-message :is(.quoted-sender, .quoted-text) {
    display: block !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    padding-left: 4px !important;
    color: #999999 !important;
    font-size: 10px !important;
    line-height: 1.32 !important;
    white-space: nowrap !important;
    overflow: hidden !important;
    text-overflow: ellipsis !important;
    text-shadow: none !important;
}
#chat-room-screen .quoted-message .quoted-sender {
    margin-bottom: 2px !important;
    font-weight: 650 !important;
}
#chat-room-screen .quoted-message .quoted-text {
    font-weight: 450 !important;
}
body.night-mode-active #chat-room-screen .quoted-message {
    background: rgba(232,238,243,0.46) !important;
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(198,210,220,0.42) !important;
}
body.night-mode-active #chat-room-screen .quoted-message .quoted-sender {
    color: #7e93a6 !important;
}
body.night-mode-active #chat-room-screen .quoted-message .quoted-text {
    color: #9aa3ad !important;
}
/* 输入框上方的待发送引用预览也使用同一配色，显隐仍由 Uwu 控制。 */
#chat-room-screen #reply-preview-bar {
    background: #f8f3f5 !important;
    border-color: #eee7ea !important;
    backdrop-filter: none !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
}
#chat-room-screen .reply-preview-content {
    border-left-color: #d6d6d6 !important;
}
#chat-room-screen :is(.reply-preview-name, .reply-preview-text, #cancel-reply-btn) {
    color: #999999 !important;
}


/* 10. 描边字幕式翻译（按用户参考图调整，非原作者提供）。
   推荐：聊天设置 → 翻译显示样式 → 气泡外 (默认)。
   无底框、奶白实心粗字、暖灰粉外沿，贴近原文气泡下沿。
   禁用 text-stroke，避免细笔画被描边覆盖成空心字；只在字外侧添加细阴影。
   不改原文气泡颜色；译文依旧点击原文展开/收起。
   译文参与排版，长译文会换行，不使用固定高度或绝对定位。
   左右、头像隐藏及群聊对齐继续沿用 Uwu 自身规则。
   气泡内两种模式也统一字效，但位置遵循用户选择。 */

#chat-room-screen {
    --angel-translation-fill: #fffafb;
    --angel-translation-outline: #9b9096;
    --angel-translation-size: calc(16px * var(--app-font-scale, 1));
}

/* 字效同时明确应用到译文及其富文本，避免继承空心描边。
   填充和阴影写在同一个元素上，阴影绘制在实心文字后方。 */
#chat-room-screen .translation-text,
#chat-room-screen .translation-text *,
#chat-room-screen .bilingual-bubble .translation-inner,
#chat-room-screen .bilingual-bubble .translation-inner * {
    color: var(--angel-translation-fill) !important;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--angel-translation-fill) !important;
    -webkit-text-stroke: 0 transparent !important;
    paint-order: normal !important;
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif !important;
    font-size: var(--angel-translation-size) !important;
    font-weight: 900 !important;
    font-synthesis: weight !important;
    line-height: 1.4 !important;
    letter-spacing: 0 !important;
    opacity: 1 !important;
    text-shadow:
        -0.7px 0 0 var(--angel-translation-outline),
         0.7px 0 0 var(--angel-translation-outline),
         0 -0.7px 0 var(--angel-translation-outline),
         0 0.7px 0 var(--angel-translation-outline),
        -0.5px -0.5px 0 var(--angel-translation-outline),
         0.5px -0.5px 0 var(--angel-translation-outline),
        -0.5px 0.5px 0 var(--angel-translation-outline),
         0.5px 0.5px 0 var(--angel-translation-outline) !important;
}
#chat-room-screen .translation-text,
#chat-room-screen .bilingual-bubble .translation-inner {
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
    padding: 0 2px !important;
    border: none !important;
    border-radius: 0 !important;
    background: transparent !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    white-space: pre-wrap !important;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere !important;
    word-break: normal !important;
    overflow: visible !important;
    backdrop-filter: none !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
}

/* 气泡外：去掉卡片间隔，轻微贴近下沿；显隐仍由 .active 控制。
   不覆盖左右 margin/max-width，以兼容头像隐藏与不同聊天布局。 */
#chat-room-screen .translation-text {
    position: relative !important;
    z-index: 3 !important;
    margin-top: -10px !important;
    margin-bottom: 3px !important;
    text-align: left !important;
}
#chat-room-screen .message-wrapper.sent .translation-text {
    text-align: right !important;
}

/* 内部模式仅统一字幕字效，不把任意长度的译文绝对定位到气泡外。 */
#chat-room-screen .bilingual-bubble .translation-inner {
    min-width: 0 !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
    margin: 3px 0 0 !important;
}
#chat-room-screen .bilingual-bubble:is(.inner-style, .inner-no-line-style) {
    gap: 0 !important;
}
#chat-room-screen .bilingual-bubble .bilingual-divider {
    display: none !important;
}


/* 11. 照片/视频消息封面：奶粉色爱心底 + 天使小熊。
   素材来自 Pinterest，图片保留原 SAN-X 标识。
   图片直链：https://i.pinimg.com/originals/6b/05/ef/6b05ef59361c9e9afce8aeb0373865c5.jpg
   以下直接内嵌同一图片，不需要额外上传图床或访问 Pinterest。
   只替换 Uwu 的描述式照片卡封面；表情包和真实图片继续展示原内容。
   不设置 opacity/display，保留点击 .hidden 展开文字，再点击恢复封面。 */
#chat-room-screen {
    --angel-photo-cover: url("data:image/jpeg;base64,");
}
#chat-room-screen .pv-card {
    width: 184px !important;
    max-width: calc(100vw - 96px) !important;
    aspect-ratio: 16 / 9 !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
    border: 1px solid #eee3e7 !important;
    border-radius: 11px !important;
    background-color: #f5ebef !important;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #faf5f7 !important;
}
#chat-room-screen .pv-card-image-overlay {
    background-image: var(--angel-photo-cover) !important;
    background-size: cover !important;
    background-position: center !important;
    background-repeat: no-repeat !important;
}
#chat-room-screen .pv-card-footer {
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
    padding: 14px 8px 6px !important;
    font-size: calc(10px * var(--app-font-scale, 1)) !important;
    background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(99,78,89,0.42), transparent) !important;
    color: #ffffff !important;
    text-shadow: none !important;
}
